name: area-chart
title: Area chart
description: A value over time as filled areas, one or several series, with a legend, tooltip and data table.

when: A total and its trend over time.

instead.when: Several series are compared, not summed.
Periods are compared as discrete values.

keyboard.does: Moves between data points; the tooltip follows.

builtIn: A "Show as table" button shows the same data as a table, which screen readers get by default.
youProvide: A title that says what the figure is.

genui.description: A trend over time. Rows are periods; categories are the numeric columns drawn (at most five).
